title: A scanner for small documents
description: A manual frame and a check of the small print help to keep a receipt or a card whole.

blocks.text: On a small receipt the fine print can blur while the shot is being taken. The review ties that to the choice of lens; a manual frame after the shot will not bring the lost detail back.

quote.text: Whose bad idea was it to force the iPhone Ultra Wide lens to capture the scans now? PUT IT BACK! Text on small receipts is so blurry and low res now. HATE IT.

blocks.text: Let the document be reshot with a camera mode that is available, then let the corners be corrected. Before it is added to the set, show a magnified fragment: the amount and the date on the receipt, for instance.

Check that the small print can be read in the final PDF on the various phones that are supported. This is a specific question of scanner quality; a separate product makes sense only for an audience that shoots documents like these regularly.
